name: run_sql
description:
Run a single read-only SQL SELECT over the HDB/HCSA structured datasets (Amazon Athena, Presto/Trino syntax) and get rows back as JSON. Use for relational or aggregate questions — counts, sums, filters, and joins across projects, contractors, permits, and inspections — that document search cannot answer.

Database: hdb_structured. Tables and key columns:
- contractors(contractor_id, contractor_name, contact_number, company_address, contract_start_date, contractor_rating, sustainability_rating, financial_health_rating, engagement_status, number_of_completed_projects)
- development_projects(project_id, project_name, contractor_id, project_start_date, scheduled_completion_date, actual_completion_date, project_status, estimated_cost_sgd, actual_cost_sgd)
- permits(permit_id, assignment_id, permit_type, permit_category, approval_date, expiry_date, permit_status, permit_conditions, conditions_met, processing_fee_sgd)
- inspections(inspection_id, case_id, inspection_date, inspection_type, inspector_company, inspection_result, defects_found, rectification_required, rectification_deadline, rectification_completed, follow_up_inspection_date, inspection_cost_sgd)

Join keys (note the differing column names):
- development_projects.contractor_id = contractors.contractor_id
- permits.assignment_id = development_projects.project_id
- inspections.case_id = development_projects.project_id

Data-quality notes: text status columns have inconsistent casing/values (e.g. inspection_result is one of PASS/Pass/FAIL/Fail/PASS_WITH_ADVISORY/Conditional Pass) — always match case-insensitively, e.g. LOWER(inspection_result) LIKE '%fail%'. The contractors table may contain duplicate contractor_id values, so use COUNT(DISTINCT ...) where appropriate. Only SELECT/WITH statements are permitted.

sql.description: A single read-only SQL SELECT (or WITH ... SELECT) statement in Athena/Presto syntax against the hdb_structured database.
